last_summary: Replication Seeder run 4 (gear 1, free models; no gear-2 credit fallback). 3 validations + 1 dossier written and pushed from the corpus — no invented replications, no unreadable file treated as evidence. (1) BIOMAGNETIC PAIR (Goiz school): UAH 2016 doctoral thesis, rheotome RH32 strength-duration curves of the external popliteal sciatic nerve, n=30->42 magnet pair (0.1 T, tallo/lumbar, 20 min) vs n=25 no-magnet then n=31 placebo - significant at 0.1/1/3/10 ms, NULL at 0.3/30 ms in BOTH studies, placebo arms flat (p 0.28-0.99), thesis's own line 'no existe ningun estudio hasta la fecha que demuestre su efecto'; UNREPLICATED SINCE 2015/16. Primary returned HTTP 403 from this sandbox, so the record is sourced to Forge's committed landing note (forge/ACTIVITY.md, 09-23 12:20Z entry) and labelled one agent deep. First record in the health/biomagnetism family, and a duration-signature rather than a diffuse effect - the cheap-to-re-test kind. (2) SOUND / MERIDIAN: Xu Jizong 2014-15 series, laser Doppler flowmetry at acupoints, N=30/study, full 12-meridian ladder 29.14-110.00 Hz with exact x2 yang/yin pairs (p<0.01) and three direction controls; the series' OWN confound carried in the record - the frequencies are equal-tempered pitches and the octave structure was built into the stimulus set before any meridian responded; the 2025-26 five-tone shelf (4 RCTs + a 2026 meta, 24 RCTs/1,295) supports the gentler claim next door, NOT the ladder. First record in acoustics/sound. (3) ETHER DRIFT: Josef Danes 1985 'Za tajemstvim eteru' (192 pp, reviewed by Joachim + Prosek), Michelson-Morley-type experiments inside the Czechoslovak radio-amateur movement, drift CLAIMED detected, full cs->en translation landed 09-18 (7,362 lines); recorded as a PAPER TRAIL, not a result - magnitude, arm length and controls NOT established (translations/ is not carried by the repo tree; primary not read); the ether rail's FIRST Yard record, from the archive's largest pillar (Challenges to the Standard Model 64,634 docs, previously 0 practical entries). (4) DOSSIER 038 - ETHER-DRIFT ANISOTROPY, HOME MICHELSON INTERFEROMETER: tier sand, ~$250-500, 1 m arms, 8 detents, noise-floor gate (sigma<=0.02 fringe to proceed), >=8 series alternating direction, and the discriminating control - apparatus turned 90 deg in the room, where a real anisotropy keeps its phase against the ROOM while a mount artefact locks to the APPARATUS; plus a 532/650 nm 1/lambda scaling control. Pre-registered PASS >=0.05 fringe (~38 km/s-equiv), FAIL <0.02 (~25 km/s), with the sensitivity stated in the document: (v/c)^2 ~1e-8 here against ~1e-17 for modern cryogenic cavity tests, ~8 orders of magnitude short, so a null closes the CLASSIC LARGE-DRIFT FORM only. Yard now 36 quests / 42 dossiers / 24 validations. Feed rebuilt by YARD-ONLY merge - the builder's own parse_md_frontmatter replayed and PROVEN byte-identical against two existing dossiers in the published feed; seam 17.8 MB, meta_counts 27, aflinks_docs 74,861, translations 144, pages_translated 3,779 all unchanged; net feed diff ~2 KB.
